exclusions: Items already represented by canonical URL, platform ID, or content hash

definition_of_done: The assigned public-web discovery shard and UTC window were searched
Primary publications were preferred and upstream lineage was recorded
Canonical URLs, timestamps, language, quote locators, and access failures were recorded
Candidate source profiles and follow-up task proposals were persisted when justified

result.summary: Completed the bounded public-web military-analyst scan. Added four draft source candidates, recorded one inaccessible ISW August 3 candidate with day-level time uncertainty, found no publication verifiably inside the exact UTC window, and persisted out-of-window leads, access failures, and follow-up proposals.
coverage_gaps: Search and connector indexes lagged several live analyst sites and did not expose complete August 3-4 archives.
The exact publication timestamp and full text of the ISW August 3 candidate were unavailable because the primary page returned HTTP 403.
No site-native RSS/API or authenticated archive access was available; the open internet was not exhaustively searched.
